samples.name: The Ordinary World
samples.power: Stasis Loop. Play this to cancel any Quest progression this turn. Narrate why nothing can change.
samples.lore: Dysfunction isn't just a state; it's a habit. We normalize the abnormal until the extraordinary seems impossible.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink-watercolor. Subject: rabbit frozen in grey domestic routine loop. Mood: comfortable numbness.

samples.name: The Call to Adventure
samples.power: Cognitive Dissonance. Increase Quest Die by +1. Force another player to introduce a conflict that disrupts their current plans.
samples.lore: The universe doesn't knock. It throws a brick. The disruption of normalcy is always the beginning.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink-watercolor. Subject: rabbit startled by cosmic brick crashing through a window. Mood: electric shock.

samples.name: The Cosmic Alphabet Soup
samples.power: Entropy Drain. Tap this card to force your opponent to randomly shuffle their deck until something vaguely meaningful is achieved.
samples.lore: The universe loves cosmic chaos. But given infinite time, randomness accidentally spells out perfect, brief order.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: cartoon cosmic horror. Subject: raccoon stirring giant alphabet soup galaxy. Mood: chaotic wonder.

samples.name: The Floating Space-Brain
samples.power: Existential Crisis. Target player must skip their next two turns questioning whether they've generated an artificial ego.
samples.lore: You never evolved. You are just a random statistical blip of order with fake memories of a past that never happened.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: retro sci-fi cartoon. Subject: disembodied brain floating in space with 3D glasses and popcorn. Mood: gleeful dread.

items.title: Propositum 2040: Forget Utopia, Ignore Dystopia, Embrace Protopia

samples.name: The Utopian Mirage
samples.power: Skip a turn while staring at the clouds; discard one resource to the Dystopia pile.
samples.lore: A fictional default built on somebody else's dystopia.
samples.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Poodle floating on clouds above scurrying rats. Dreamy absurdist.

samples.name: The Dystopian Apathy
samples.power: Board freezes for one round. Player collects 3 profit tokens from the burning bank.
samples.lore: A cautionary tale that devolved into desperate escapism and a disaster capitalism product roadmap.
samples.artworkPrompt: Ink & watercolor. Sloth in VR goggles eating popcorn, forest ablaze behind. Darkly comic.

items.title: Pulitzer Punk — Kayfabizarro #05
items.deckType: Writing Craft / Character Psychology / Honesty vs. Fidelity

samples.name: The Outer Shell
samples.power: Surface Tension. Deflect 1 attack using "Traits." Opponent must address your haircut instead of your core.
samples.lore: The psychic economy of the character. The traits, the green shirt, the tan insignia — a delicate shell hiding the rot inside.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ink wash, parchment. Subject: split face mask, smooth exterior / rotten interior. Mood: unsettling calm.

samples.name: The Mannerism Twitch
samples.power: Subconscious Betrayal. Force opponent to reveal a card.
samples.lore: Why do you hold your hand like that? To set people at ease? Or to hide the shaking? Multiple humans use the same crutch.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ink wash, parchment. Subject: hand gripping syringe, other hand trembling behind back. Mood: nervous concealment.

samples.name: UNCLE FRIZZLEBOB
samples.power: Epistemic Sabotage – Play this card to immediately void all rules you were taught in Economics 101.
samples.lore: Reality is what we imagine it to be. I imagine you're all being scammed.
samples.artworkPrompt: Frantic yellow rabbit with frying pan explodes through economics textbook. Style: ink + watercolor. Subject: FrizzleBob mid-chaos. Mood: anarchic glee.

samples.name: KANTIAN NOUMENA
samples.power: The Unknowable Real – Target player realizes their senses are liars and skips a turn staring into the void.
samples.lore: The true objective reality. You can't see it, touch it, or understand it. So stop pretending you do.
samples.artworkPrompt: Dark tentacled cosmic horror looms; badger peers through doorway. Style: ink wash. Subject: Noumena vs. curious animal. Mood: existential dread.

samples.name: THE COLD MONSTER
samples.power: Absorb 10 Freedom tokens from all players. You now hold the Monopoly on Violence.
samples.lore: Nietzsche was right. The state is a cold-blooded monster that only exists to maintain its own power.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink wash political cartoon. Subject: monstrous crowned bear with dripping claws. Mood: cold bureaucratic menace.

samples.name: PLURALISM SIMULATOR
samples.power: Target player wastes 2 turns arguing with themselves. Nothing changes.
samples.lore: Two identical parties ensure the masses can throw the rascals out without changing the policy.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor satire. Subject: two ostriches with blue and red ties, heads in sand sandbox. Mood: absurd futility.

samples.name: The First Wall (Jericho)
samples.power: Paranoia. +1 Defense, -5 Chill.
samples.lore: 11,000 years ago, someone looked at their house and immediately thought about how to stop other people from taking it.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ancient carved relief. Subject: paranoid stone-cutter stacking rocks at dawn. Mood: primal anxiety.

samples.name: The Water Source
samples.power: Thirst Trap. If you forgot to enclose the well, the siege is already over.
samples.lore: The city that builds walls without water inside has solved invasion but created a death sentence.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: medieval manuscript marginalia. Subject: empty stone well surrounded by besieging army. Mood: grim irony.

items.title: What Work Was For: A Field Report from Before the Timesheet — Vol. I

samples.name: The Necessary Motion
samples.power: Generates raw survival.
samples.lore: The bend worn into the earth over generations.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: dark watercolor. Subject: badger clawing earth at dusk near ancient trail groove. Mood: urgent, ancestral.

samples.name: The First Division
samples.power: Sorts the pack by utility.
samples.lore: The bad knee guards the young; the keen eye takes the high branches.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: naturalist watercolor. Subject: owl perched high, wolf running below in twilight forest. Mood: efficient, hierarchical.

samples.name: Therefore / But
samples.power: Chain actions via causal logic
samples.lore: Story coherence enforced
samples.artworkPrompt: Comic panel arrows cause effect explosion logic diagram

samples.name: Blödsinn!
samples.power: Call bullshit; nullify or lose turn

samples.artworkPrompt: Snake shouting absurdity smashing rule tablet chaotic

items.title: Politics — The Starter Set of Doom: 5,000 Years of Bad Ideas & One Very Tired Ballot Box

samples.name: The City-State
samples.power: Ostracism: Exile any player who becomes too powerful. The audience talks back.
samples.lore: Aristotle called us political animals. He meant it as a compliment. We have complicated the assessment.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink-wash watercolor. Subject: wise owl atop cracked Greek amphora. Mood: civic melancholy.

samples.name: The Caesar
samples.power: The Worked Shoot: Violate the constitution publicly. Generals must disband armies; you kept yours.
samples.lore: The Republic survived the crossing. The political reality did not.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: dramatic watercolor. Subject: armored wolf-general wading river in full battle splatter. Mood: triumphant menace.

samples.name: The Editor Reflex
samples.power: Cancel last card played
samples.lore: Kills ideas before they breathe
samples.artworkPrompt: Angry cat editor slashing paper with red pen

samples.name: The Consensus Trap
samples.power: Merge ideas into bland average
samples.lore: Nobody loses, nothing matters
samples.artworkPrompt: Group of birds merging into gray blob consensus

samples.name: Uncle FrizzleBob, The Curator
samples.power: Documents domestic decay with awe, dread, and a clipboard held too close to the chest.
samples.lore: The jokes are just a shield to let the truth slip in behind them.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor comic. Subject: Yellow rabbit curator surveying paper avalanche with clipboard. Mood: Aghast authority.

samples.name: The Marvelous Miss Messy
samples.power: Rejects the concept of putting things back so completely that the room becomes the work.
samples.lore: Chaos isn't an accident; it's a fractal, self-organizing lifestyle choice.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor. Subject: Raccoon queen enthroned in glorious mess, crown askew. Mood: Regal chaos.

samples.name: Andvari (The Mole)
samples.power: Asset Freeze: Target player cannot draw cards next turn. They are auditing their hoard.
samples.lore: He sat on the gold until Loki squeezed him like a stress ball. It's not hoarding if you're underground.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: medieval illumination. Subject: anxious mole hoarding gold underground. Mood: paranoid auditor.

samples.name: Loki (The Fox)
samples.power: Forced Liquidation: Steal a card from an opponent. If they complain, steal another.
samples.lore: He caught the pike, killed the otter, and enslaved the dwarf. Basically, a standard consultant.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: medieval illumination. Subject: smug fox in consultant suit stealing from others. Mood: gleefully amoral.

samples.name: UNCLE FRIZZLEBOB
samples.power: Narrative Sabotage. Dispels techno-scenic illusions in a 5-mile radius.
samples.lore: The layout anarchist who sees through the Kayfabe. He's here to ruin Big Tech's meticulously curated PR with a sloppy bucket of watercolour ink.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro ink. Subject: anarchist rabbit flinging watercolor at tech billboard. Mood: gleeful sabotage.

samples.name: OBSERVATIONSÖKONOMIE (The Attention Economy)
samples.power: Extracts 6 hours and 58 minutes of lifespan daily from 86% of global players.
samples.lore: The digital panopticon disguised as a convenience utopia. You aren't the customer; your brain chemistry is the product.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro editorial. Subject: glowing eye-tower harvesting tiny humans on hamster wheels. Mood: clinical dread.
